card.title: McCleary District Meanwhile Uses — Lake Shore Boulevard East
card.what_is_proposed: Allow temporary non-residential meanwhile uses at specified McCleary District sites through amendments to the Official Plan and zoning by-law.
card.why: To use vacant or underused buildings and land for activities before long-term redevelopment.
card.who_is_affected: People and organizations near the five identified sites in Ward 14 (Toronto–Danforth).

stages.quote: This report reviews and recommends approval
City Council adopted this item on April 22 and 23, 2026 without amendments.

conditions: The Council decision includes provisions relating to required provincial approvals and natural-hazard protocols before by-laws are enacted, if applicable.

procedural_phrases.meaning_here: City Council adopted the item without changing the committee-recommended text at that stage.
procedural_phrases.quote: adopted this item on April 22 and 23, 2026 without amendments.

uncertainties: The item does not establish a currently open public comment period; the statutory public meeting was April 14, 2026.
